ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 75% high-intensity (white) pixels across the central ventral surface, bounded by low-intensity (black) pixels along the trailing edges and peduncle.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive high-intensity contiguous white mottling covering the majority of both lobes, punctuated by low-intensity black geometric blobs along the trailing margin and a solid black region at the fluke's center where it meets the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression; calculated pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees; depth extends significantly into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with low pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys localized along the entire linear boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trajectory on the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to acute, slightly upward-curved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial detection of circular high-contrast white-on-black pixel clusters concentrated near the center and lower margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the inner portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular notch and jagged pixel-contouring on the trailing edge of the left lobe, indicating minor physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'stardust' pattern of white pigmentation dots localized specifically around the central notch and trailing margins.
